findings.title: Root module has no required_providers / required_version constraint
findings.explanation: The root module has no terraform{} block declaring required_providers or required_version. This was initially flagged and fixed, but the user's stated convention for this repo is that reusable/child modules should not carry their own terraform{} block at all — only the calling root module declares required_providers/required_version. The example under example/examplea/terraform.tf still does this correctly, which is the intended place for it.
findings.remediation: No action — suppressed per user preference. Do not add a terraform.tf/versions.tf to this module root in future scans.
